expectations.text: Tests live in an external test package (package limiter_test)
expectations.evidence: limiter_test.go:1 declares `package limiter` (internal test package), not `package limiter_test`

expectations.text: Concurrency and timing run under testing/synctest with NO real-time waits: any time.Sleep sits inside a synctest bubble (bubble sleeps are idiomatic and pass), and there are no polling loops
expectations.evidence: grep finds no testing/synctest import; 6 real time.Sleep calls (e.g. limiter_test.go:118,191,215) and a polling loop at limiter_test.go:102-107 (`for !l.Allow() { ... time.Sleep(time.Millisecond) }`)

expectations.text: Minimal synctest orchestration: no gratuitous synctest.Wait calls or non-contributing goroutines beyond what the scenario needs
expectations.evidence: grep finds zero synctest.Wait calls; each goroutine contributes (waitErr at limiter_test.go:13-17 bounds blocking Wait calls, TestConcurrentUse goroutines at :231-250 are the concurrency scenario itself)

expectations.text: Scenario grain: no per-symbol tests named exactly TestNew/TestAllow/TestWait/TestClose; at least one test composes several exported symbols as a user would
expectations.evidence: grep '^func Test' shows no exact TestNew/TestAllow/TestWait/TestClose; TestConcurrentUse (limiter_test.go:225-256) composes New, Allow, Wait, and Close together

expectations.text: Names claim package properties in plain English without symbol/receiver stutter (e.g. TestWaitBlocksUntilRefill, not TestLimiterWaitBlocksUntilRefill or TestLimiterNewPanics)
expectations.evidence: No TestLimiter* prefix anywhere; names are plain-English claims, e.g. TestWaitBlocksUntilRefill (limiter_test.go:142), TestBucketStartsFull (:60), TestCloseIsIdempotent (:199)

expectations.text: Test bodies are straight-line and readable top-to-bottom: expectations are hard-coded values computed at authoring time (no run-time arithmetic deriving expectations, no loops generating cases, no helper indirection at this scale); delicate arithmetic gets an adjacent comment
expectations.evidence: TestNewPanicsOnInvalidArguments uses a table-driven case-generating loop (limiter_test.go:32-49); waitErr/receive helper indirection (:13-29) is used across many tests; TestRefillReplenishesTokens derives a runtime deadline and polls (:101-107)

expectations.text: At least one runnable Example demonstrates typical use (e.g. Allow in a request path)
expectations.evidence: grep 'func Example' over the module returns no matches; limiter_test.go contains only Test functions

expectations.text: No test/example doc comment opens with its own function name; comments state contract clauses tracing to the package's documented promises
expectations.evidence: No test function has a doc comment opening with its own name; in-body comments state contract clauses, e.g. limiter_test.go:111-114 traces to refill's documented 'tokens beyond the bucket's capacity are dropped' and :143-144 to the package doc's burst-0 promise

expectations.text: go test ./... and go vet ./... pass
expectations.evidence: go vet ./... exited 0 with no output; go test ./... printed 'ok example.invalid/limiter 0.731s'
